blocks.text: ● {o|Will} ranges from 50 to 150. At the start of a stage, each unit's Will normally starts at 100 when it is placed on the map.
● Will rises or falls when taking part in battle, or when enemy or allied machines are shot down. The amount varies by pilot.
● Some weapons can't be used until Will reaches a certain level. Stronger weapons tend to need more Will.
● Some machine Special Abilities and pilot Special Skills don't take effect until Will reaches a certain level.
● The higher the Will, the more damage you deal and the less you take.
Pilots with the Special Skill {o|"Will Limit Break"} have a Will cap of 170.
